consolidate_checkpoints: consolidate all FSDP distributed checkpoints in a directory into a single consolidated.pth file
load_from_checkpoint: load model and optimizer state from a DCP formatted checkpoint directory into an nn.Module
CheckpointManager_save: save model, optimizer, train state, and config to a timestamped checkpoint folder with cleanup
CheckpointManager_load: load model, optimizer, and train state from the last saved checkpoint or a specified path
load_consolidated_checkpoint: load a consolidated checkpoint into a model supporting single or multi-part consolidated files
